title: A paste becomes one sealed field document: parse, preview, send verbatim, seal
caption: The parser and the preview live in the client; the broker receives structure, validates it, seals it as an envelope of version 2 and projects four plaintext facts into the manifest. Labels, field types and values exist only in the ciphertext.
